physical_resource_inventory.accounting: Per-trajectory resources count its logical decision graph. These physical totals count each shared accepted call once. Allocated inference time is measured engine batch wall time divided across its requests, not dedicated per-request GPU time. Monetary cost is not observed.

interpretation: Positive correctness effects are beneficial; positive retention effects mean more explicit scoped information survived. Broader development/subgroup contrasts are exploratory. Confidence is not reliability.
